name: robots/robocasa__robocasa-gr1-tabletop-tasks
title: RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop task (Gymnasium GrootRoboCasaEnv)
intro: RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop task (Gymnasium GrootRoboCasaEnv), adapted from robocasa/robocasa-gr1-tabletop-tasks. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
